// diagnostic

E0369

`{name}` appears twice in this fence.

What

`{name}` appears twice in this fence.

Why

One binding fence must name each generated copy once.

Fix

remove the second name or give it a different name.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0369: tests/ui/fenced_name_duplicate.stderr.

Error [E0369]: `same` appears twice in this fence
  --> tests/ui/fenced_name_duplicate.jet:2:14
    |
  2 |     @[ same, same ]@ :: 1
    |              ^^^^
 Why: one binding fence must name each generated copy once
 Fix: remove the second `same` or give it a different name
